name: Kinu M47
details: Hand grinder with 47 mm conical burrs; settings in rotations from zero. The Classic, Simplicity and Phoenix share one chart.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0.3–1.3, espresso 1.1–2.3, moka pot 2.2–4, AeroPress 2–5.8, V60 2.5–4.2, filter coffee machine 1.9–5.4, French press 4.2–7.8, cold brew 4.9–8.5. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. Same table on its Simplicity and Phoenix pages.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
